I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Moss's Coastal digest from Sunday 2025-11-02 says Pellucid Harbor Logistics "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03", so the date is 2025-11-03.

I also warned her that "PHL" is shared with Covey & Lark Retail, now Pellow Home Living. She should make sure the tracker row is the port-logistics account.
